preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
Each test case must have an array length N between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= B[i] <= 10**5 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element B[i] in the array must be either -1 or a non-negative integer not exceeding 100,000.
The total length of all arrays across test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not valid_array_exists else all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: If no valid array A exists, output -1; otherwise, output an array A where each element is between 0 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all((B[i] >= 0 and mex(A[:i+1]) == B[i]) or (B[i] == -1) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: For each index i, if B[i] is non-negative, the mex of the first i+1 elements of A must equal B[i]; if B[i] is -1, there is no constraint.
